edges.rationale: Raw data must be gathered, filtered, and deduplicated before it can be annotated and quality-controlled.
A curated dataset foundation is typically needed to guide synthetic data generation and ensure diversity/volume balance.
Annotation guidelines and quality standards from labeled data inform how synthetic data is created and verified.
A dataset must exist and be curated before models can be trained on it and evaluated on downstream benchmarks.
Accurate, quality-controlled annotations are needed to produce reliable dataset quality assessments and benchmark results.
Synthetic data must be generated and verified before it can be included in dataset evaluation and benchmarking.
